label: Fugue in G major, BWV 577
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass.
title: Fugue in G major, BWV 577

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (7 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Link (bar 62).
sections.leads: From D major to B minor; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 35

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From B minor to E minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (7 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From E minor to G major

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 30–34) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G major to D major; perfect cadence in D major at bar 63

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From D major to B minor

sections.label: Subject in B minor, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B minor to G major; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 75; perfect cadence in B minor at bar 75
